job.meaning: «Ночной город»: плоская минималистичная анимация, графитово-фиолетовый #3A3550, жёлтые окна #E8B04B, салатовый акцент #C6F432
job.prompt: Create a complete design system board (style guide sheet, 16:9) for a series of VERTICAL 9:16 animated Reels «Представь: у тебя 0 ₽ и 30 дней». There is NO presenter: the viewer is the hero — a simple FACELESS character «ты» (no facial features, so anyone can imagine themselves), shown in second-person stories. Story of episode 1: you wake up, your bank card shows exactly 0 ₽, payday is in 30 days; you check the kitchen cupboards (buckwheat, pasta, three eggs, tea), stop taking the bus and walk, put an old phone up for sale, and in the evening a notification «Списание по подписке −399 ₽» turns your balance negative. Blocks on the board: title «Представь · 0 ₽ и 30 дней», colour palette with HEX codes, typography, the faceless hero in 3 poses (waking up on the bed, walking, holding a phone), a game-like TOP PANEL «ДЕНЬ 1/30 · БАЛАНС 0 ₽», a RULE card «ПРАВИЛО 1 · Не паникуй — посчитай», SUBTITLES style (big bold words, one key word highlighted), a phone notification card «Списание по подписке −399 ₽», an end card «ДЕНЬ 2 — ЗАВТРА», and a block «КАДРЫ 9:16» with 4 phone-shaped frames: (1) dark bedroom, hero sits on the bed, phone screen «0 ₽»; (2) open kitchen cupboard with food items and a label «≈ 7 дней еды»; (3) bus stop with a crossed-out bus, hero walking; (4) evening window and the notification. In every phone frame keep text away from the top 13% and the bottom 22% (Instagram interface zones). All text in Russian, short, correctly spelled. No real brand logos. Style: FLAT MINIMALIST 2D animation, clean geometric shapes, no outlines, soft long shadows, quiet night city of panel apartment blocks with lit windows. Palette: graphite-violet #3A3550 and #24212F background, warm window yellow #E8B04B, lime accent #C6F432 for highlights and the key subtitle word, white text, alarm red #FF5A4E only for minus balance. Typography: «Montserrat» ExtraBold uppercase for subtitles and headlines. The hero is a slim white figure with a round head without a face, wearing a dark blue hoodie.
